very nice place to dine with a small group. the decoration was cozy and ancient, making the space very comfortable.

highly recommended!!!

Written May 18, 2026
Vu A
Dear Nhu Nguyen,
Thank you so much for your lovely and detailed review on TripAdvisor. We’re truly delighted to know that you and your group had such an enjoyable evening at Blanc.
We would also love to thank you for sharing your beautiful photos along with the review. Your pictures captured the warmth, atmosphere, and little details of the experience so beautifully, and our team genuinely enjoyed seeing Blanc through your perspective.
It’s wonderful to hear that you appreciated the cosy atmosphere of the space. We designed Blanc to feel warm, intimate, and welcoming - almost like stepping into a hidden little oasis in the middle of Saigon - so your words mean a lot to us.
We’re especially touched by your kind comments about our team. Creating genuine, caring interactions is at the heart of the Blanc experience, and knowing that our staff helped elevate your evening “to the max” truly makes us smile.
We’re also thrilled that you enjoyed the Saigon Set Menu. Our culinary team carefully designs each course to create a balanced and satisfying journey, where flavours, textures, and portions gradually unfold throughout the meal. It’s always rewarding to hear when guests finish the experience feeling both delighted and fulfilled.
Thank you as well for recommending Blanc so warmly and for mentioning the smooth pacing of the service. Thoughtful tips like yours are incredibly helpful for future guests.
If you enjoyed your experience, we would be so grateful if you could continue recommending Blanc to your friends or fellow travellers visiting Saigon. Your support truly helps us continue our journey of creating meaningful and inclusive dining experiences.
We look forward to welcoming you back again soon for another memorable evening.
With peaceful regards,
Tú | Co-Founder of Journey of the Senses | Blanc. Restaurant

The food is first class and the experience is memorable.
Apr 2025 • Friends
Came for my Birthday as we are members of the deaf community from Australia and wanted the experience. Party of 16 from my tour group who all had a great time and loved the experience. The food is top notch and if you like fine dining this is the place to visit.
Written April 21, 2025
Vu A
Dear Ms Lynda and Mr Herbert,

Thank you for celebrating your birthday with us and for sharing such a glowing review! We were honored to welcome you and your party of 16 from the Australian deaf community for this special occasion.

Creating memorable moments is at the heart of what we do. We’re thrilled that our fine‑dining menu, featuring meticulously crafted courses and thoughtfully paired flavors, exceeded your expectations. From the first aperitif to the final dessert, every detail—from the presentation on hand‑painted plates to the ambient lighting—was designed to delight your senses.

Equally important to us is the shared connection forged through HCMC sign language. It was a privilege to see your group engage with our deaf and hearing‑impaired staff, learning signs and sharing laughter throughout the evening. These genuine interactions, we believe, elevate a meal into an unforgettable experience.

We hope the atmosphere—anchored by elegant décor, curated music, and the warm glow of candlelight—added to the sense of celebration. Our kitchen team is already inspired by your feedback and looks forward to dreaming up new creations that will continue to surprise and delight.

Thank you again for letting Blanc be a part of your birthday celebration. It was our pleasure to host you and your friends, and we look forward to welcoming you back for more fine‑dining adventures and heartfelt connections.

Happy birthday and all the best from Vietnam! 

With peaceful regards,
Tú (Mr) | Vũ Anh Tú
Co‑Founder of Journey of the Senses

A beautifully crafted dining space with the focus on people and arts!
Sep 2022
This is a must-visit location when you are in the city whether you are a local or you are visiting. Blanc. is a twin restaurant to Noir Dining in the Dark. If you come to Noir and experience a complete and absolutely dining experiences in a pit-black room and the serving staff are visisually impaired, then when you come to Blanc., you are invited into a space that is decorated with carefully curated art pieces and the serving staff have hearing impairments. The food is delicious, which shows the care and dedication of the restaurants to its customers. It is also beautifully plated, and comes with a large portion that can both fill you up and allow you to taste the evolvement of the flavors. For us, Blanc. is a space of beauty, piece, openness, embracing and above all it is a place of and for the people. Highly recommend!
